I had a dream of a faraway, southern isle… A thousand miles, maybe just one. Golden sand, I close my eyes, Wake up lost in a strange paradise. Wrapped in white, sunflowers bright, Dark-eyed strangers, staring in light. They take my hand, lead me inside, Cool winds dance where the fabrics glide. Sing me a song, play me a tune, A missing string, still hums in the room. Swaying slow, I hear the past, Echoes of friends I thought wouldn’t last. Fruits so big, colors so new, Birds sing songs the sky never knew. They pour me a drink, sweet and deep, Smile so wide, my soul sinks deep. The night fades out, the stars burn bright, Lost in mist, lost in time. 為我唱首歌，為我奏一段旋律， 即使少了一根弦，房間裡依然迴盪著樂音。 我隨著節奏，緩緩搖曳， 聽見了過去的回聲， 那些我曾以為，再也無法相見的朋友。
碩大的果實，從未見過的繽紛色彩， 鳥兒唱著，連天空都未曾聽過的歌。 他們為我斟上一杯飲品，甜美而深沉， 那燦爛的笑容，讓我的靈魂漸漸沉醉。
夜色悄然褪去，繁星卻依然閃耀， 迷失在薄霧之中，迷失在時間的縫隙裡。 在月光下，漂浮著，徜徉著， 總覺得，清晨來得太早了。
